facts.material: metal articulated manipulator arm with servo motors and encoders
facts.function: multi-purpose programmable manipulation (handling, welding, painting, assembly once tooled)
facts.form: robot body/arm imported without its programmed controller (and presumably without end-of-arm tooling)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8479 covers machines having individual functions not specified elsewhere; subheading 8479.50 names industrial robots n.e.s.i.

GRI 2(a): the robot body without its controller is an incomplete article that, as presented, has the essential character of the complete industrial robot (the manipulator performs the robot's function; the controller is added after import)
Section XVI note 2 not needed: the article is classified as the incomplete machine, not as a part

rejected_alternatives.reason: the manipulator is not a mere part; under GRI 2(a) it has the essential character of the complete robot
industrial robots for lifting/handling would apply only if dedicated to material handling, which is not stated
welding robots require dedication to welding, not shown for robots without controllers or tooling

missing_facts: Are the robots dedicated to one application (welding, material handling, painting) by design or tooling?
classification.rationale: Industrial robots imported without their programmed controllers are incomplete machines; under GRI 2(a) the manipulator arm supplies the essential character of the finished robot. With no dedication to welding or material handling shown, they fall under the residual eo nomine provision 8479.50.00.00 for industrial robots n.e.s.i. HQ 962659 treated industrial robots imported incomplete (without end-of-arm tooling) under GRI 2(a) and upheld classification of non-dedicated robots in 8479.50.00.
